decisions.reason: As a flagship product line with its own page and several models, it continues to meet or exceed the firm's aspirations, and slack from growth makes withdrawal unlikely.

Close to the established offer with multiple models and its own page, it likely performs near aspiration, and given organisational slack and growth the firm will keep it rather than search for alternative uses.

As a strategically important hydrogen-capable flagship already in real operation and aligned with the firm's lower-carbon direction, its results are judged against long-term aspirations, so withdrawal is very unlikely despite any short-term uncertainty.
